method: Primary metadata independently opened; paraphrases below are verification conclusions, not direct quotations. Numerical API verification is recorded separately.

verified: PAS_CRD passengers carried uses on-flight origin/destination with one flight number.
Transfer passengers joining or leaving the flight are included; direct transit is excluded.
This differs from PAS_BRD flight-stage passengers on board and from true full-journey origin/destination.
Route dissemination uses thresholds: unreported pairs cannot be treated as zero demand.
Indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD measures GDP per capita PPP in constant 2021 international dollars.
It is a country-level economic proxy, not observed income of air travellers or residents of an airport catchment.
The accommodation statistics cover domestic and inbound tourists staying in covered rented accommodation.
NACE55.1,55.2,55.3 are the selected establishment groups.
Monthly NUTS2 nights are transmitted annually with a month breakdown; the frequency dimension A is compatible with twelve monthly values.
TOTAL residency includes residents and non-residents. Counts are nights, not arrivals or aviation passengers.
NUTS2024 is a dated geographic version; the research uses the official level2 WGS84 polygon file at1:10million.
Airport coordinate containment is reproducible, but does not establish the passenger catchment area.
